Henrico County wraps Richmond on three sides and has no incorporated towns, so the county controls all zoning from Short Pump and Innsbrook on the west end to Varina and Sandston on the east. Richmond International Airport, the White Oak Technology Park data centers and the I-64, I-95 and I-295 interchanges drive industrial and office demand, while the aging US 1 and Laburnum Avenue corridors are the redevelopment plays.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: November 8, 2026
